items.title: Independence of the Chern class, Chern character and Chern polynomials of a bounded finite locally free complex representing a perfect object
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that three invariants of a perfect object E in D(O_X) defined by choosing a locally bounded complex of finite locally free modules, namely the total Chern class, the Chern character and the Chern polynomials, do not depend on the choice of complex (statement lines 9090-9104, tag 0ESZ). The proof is a genuine three-stage reduction rather than a citation: it first glues the construction over a rank-constant open and closed decomposition, then uses a bivariant vanishing criterion to move to a proper birational integral cover on which the cohomology acquires tor dimension at most one, and finally analyses the resulting four-term diagram with Schanuel's lemma to compare two short exact sequences with a common quotient. The bookkeeping is delicate but each step is standard, so the claim is H2.
